responsibility: This file implements GCC’s branch prediction and hot/cold frequency estimation machinery across GIMPLE and RTL CFGs. It combines static heuristics from predict.def, profile data, loop iteration analysis, built-in expectations, labels and call properties into edge probabilities and block counts, maintains hotness thresholds and optimization-for-size/speed queries, updates branch probability notes, and provides utilities for forcing edges cold, redistributing probabilities, rebuilding frequencies, and reporting predictor behavior. It is the central engine for static prediction and profile-based CFG probability management.
same_name_distinction: Contains the executable branch-prediction engine that applies heuristics and profile logic to CFGs; unlike predict.def’s predictor table and predict.h’s declarations, this file computes probabilities, hotness, and frequency updates.
